weaknesses.critique: I incorrectly concluded there was INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when the system has actually computed the operating margin from the financial statements. The computed figures show Operating Income of $38,275 million and Revenue of $81,273 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, yielding an operating margin of 47.09%, which exceeds the 45% threshold stated in the claim. The evidence passages I reviewed (E1-E6) were narrative sections rather than the actual income statement, but other evidence (E7-E11) apparently contains the necessary financial statement data that I failed to properly consider.

I did not request or review the actual income statement line items from the 10-Q filing. Evidence E1 explicitly references 'Income Statements for the Three and Six Months Ended December 31, 2025 and 2024' on page 3 of the filing, indicating that the precise operating income and revenue figures are available in the filing. I should have recognized that the financial statements themselves would contain the exact figures needed to calculate operating margin.

The computed operating margin of 47.09% clearly exceeds the 45% threshold, making the claim SUPPORTED rather than having insufficient evidence. My reasoning focused too narrowly on the narrative MD&A sections provided in the evidence passages rather than recognizing that the system had access to and computed values from the actual financial statements in the same 10-Q filing.
